description: Mark a Task of the claimed Goal done, recording the files it touched and, if it changed, the final summary of what it did. Works whether or not the Task was started. For a Task that turned out unnecessary, use drop_task instead; to change a Task without finishing it, use update_task.

code.description: Files the Task touched, optionally with :line; added to the ones it has.

summary.description: One or two sentences on the fix or change the Task makes, such as 'Callback re-sets the session cookie on every hit; only set it after token exchange.'

name: complete_task
title: Complete Task
